name: Crew gear cloth: life jacket nylon shells, the knit polo, the cotton cap and shorts
kind: M_CrewFabric (scripts/make_materials.py build_crew_fabric), not a BOAT_SURFACE kind: the instances' new Kind parameter picks the cloth (1 coated nylon shell, 2 knit, 3 twill cap, 4 twill shorts; 0 none)
code: scripts/make_materials.py FABRIC_CODE, the block between '// FABRIC_WEAR >>>' and '// FABRIC_WEAR <<<'; Tools/texloop/crewfabric/port.py mirrors it

slots.MI_Crew_PFDShell: kind 1: the tailored vests (SKM_<Role>_Vest slot PFD) and the rigid fallback SM_CrewPFD; recoloured per sailor (CrewOutfit.cpp)
slots.MI_Crew_CapCloth: kind 3 (UVm 0.106: the cap's UVs are in its unit mesh)
slots.MI_Crew_Webbing, MI_Crew_ShoeLeather: kind 0, unchanged (webbing is the webbing/rubber pass's)

driver: Age and Care on the material (default -1: no wear). The pawn sets them on the crew's dynamic instances from -SailingCrewAge=<years>[,<care>] or -SailingBoatAge (player's boat only); nothing sets them in normal play yet

levels_needed.L1: a touch of sun on the shoulders, the odd pill on the polo
levels_needed.L2: school vest after several seasons: chroma down about a sixth (Bean's lesson photo: royal blue C 53 against about 61 new), lighter on the shoulders, grey-tan grime patches, a faint sweat line round the cap's band
levels_needed.L3: kept but old: faded more, matt nylon, clean
levels_needed.L4: left wet in a locker: faded, heavy grime, mildew clusters, sweat lines on the cap

drivers: fade = timeK^0.7 x kind weight x sky dose (0.35 + 0.65 (0.5 + 0.5 n.z)) x 9 cm blotch: chroma to 45% toward grey plus a warm lift; nylon roughness to 0.88 by 0.6 timeK (the PU coat goes); grime = dirtK x (0.2 + 0.8 blotch x more where it doesn't see the sky); pilling: 1.2 mm cells, share 0.3 timeK + 0.15 dirtK, within 1.5 m; tide lines round the cap's band once dirtK passes 0.2; mildew: dirtK over 0.5 and low Care, 5 cm clusters of 1.8 mm-cell specks (from afar a shadow)
replaces: M_CrewFabric had no wear: every crew's gear looked new
maps: none: shader math only (no new textures, Medium included)
out_of_scope: webbing and buckles (webbing/rubber pass), leather shoes, the MetaHuman default T-shirts, straps and seams on the vest (modelling), foul-weather jackets (no crew wears one in the slice)
